title: Shiraishi An — Don't Forget The Smile〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An & Kohane
rows.Line:
Hello!
Hello!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh, welcome, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Perfect! I was just hoping to talk to all of you♪

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Actually, An, Toya, just you two.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? Me and Toya?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: We've been telling Luka about what happened during Shibuya Instrument Day.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. You weren't there, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: No, I wasn't.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
It sounded like so much fun.
I wish you would've told me about it sooner.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You miss out on these things because you're always wandering around somewhere.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyway, what would you all like to drink? Your usuals?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes, thank you.
se_walk_women_004_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Anyway, An, Toya!
Tell me more about this convention.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure! But I dunno where to begin...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Then, how about Toya's customer service skills?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I got to see him doing a really awesome job, but the rest of you didn't, right?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes! Tell me more about how Toya did!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I haven't heard all the details yet.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Me neither. Would you mind telling us, Aoyagi?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hear that? What do you say?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I don't mind.
Especially since you all helped me practice.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Then, let's tell them what happened!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The first customers you helped were that elderly couple, right?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, they were hoping to enjoy their golden years by learning a new hobby together...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And so, after they'd made their interest clear, I suggested that they demo some instruments. The manager took over from there.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Really! Way to go, Toya♪ I can tell even from the story that you treated them very well.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
But I was only able to do that because Shiraishi coached me so well.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha! You're giving me too much credit.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But you practiced with him every day in SEKAI, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We helped by pretending to be customers.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
But Toya kept getting really nervous at first.
Even when welcoming us, he'd sound like he was angry with us or something!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! You guys were so startled that you ended up shouting, “Th-Thank you for having us...!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Really?!
After that nice story, I can hardly picture it.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I couldn't be there for everything, but you did practice like your life depended on it...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I made a commitment, so I wanted to make sure I'd actually be able to help Shiraishi and the manager.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thanks, Toya!
You know, I think you'd do great as an employee of Weekend Garage.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You do?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I feel honored by those words.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And thank you for being such a wonderful teacher, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome!
se_walk_women_004_2

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you all for your patience. Here are your drinks.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, that took longer than usual.
Would it have been better if I had lent you a hand?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I didn't want to interrupt your conversation, so I waited for my opportune moment.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But speaking of help, you'd be more than welcome to help out here any time you like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Then, how about we help right now?
You can show everyone just how much you've improved, Toya!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's a good idea.
In that case, MEIKO, would it be alright if I served these to everyone?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Alright, they're all yours.
But please be careful, Toya.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I will.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You can do it, Toya!
se_walk_men_004_1

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for your patience.
Here's your ice cream float and your lemonade.

rows.Speaker: Rin & Len
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Wow! That feels so natural!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See what I mean?!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. You look so happy, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Well, he is my star pupil!
